newsitem.title: GERMANY: German shares seek to hit new record highs in IBIS.
newsitem.headline: German shares seek to hit new record highs in IBIS.

text.p: 1345 GMT - German shares push toward new record highs in post-bourse IBIS computer dealings. Demand for banking sector shares on prospects for more deals after Vereinsbank and Hypo-Bank said on Monday they to merge fuelling market advance along with dollar rising above 1.81 marks.
* IBIS DAX up 126.34 points at 4,266.30 points. DAX ended bourse up 122.02 points at 4,230.42 points.
* CSFB raises Allianz to buy, sets price target to 560 marks. Allianz ends bourse up 36 marks at 455.50 marks.
* DMG recommends shift into Lufthansa from BA, raises 1997, 97 DVFA earnings estimates on Lufthansa.
